updates.title: What's new
updates.keyboard: Keyboard navigation: skip straight to the calculator, keep focus inside open dialogs, and return to the opener with Escape.
updates.translations: Edit the interface and game translations in the secure admin console. Published D1 edits take priority over built-in translations.
updates.builds: Search compatible equipment and Souls, save named builds locally, and compare their calculated stats without changing your current character.
updates.offline: Install the site or use Modern and Legacy modes offline after the first successful load. Save your work before accepting an update.
updates.preservation: The original Legacy 2.00 mode remains available. Modern uses the published game catalog with verified calculator corrections. This is an unofficial community project; saved builds stay in your browser.

adminShell.loginHint: Sign in to manage the Modern catalog. Legacy 2.00 remains preserved.
adminShell.capabilitiesDescription: Translate the interface, skills, requirements, equipment, Souls, classes, races and calculated values in one place. Edit RU / EN / JP / TW in the same card; search all four languages. The catalog also manages 28 classes, 18 racial passives, 178 active and 33 passive skills, equipment and Souls. New mechanics and classes outside supported rules are not yet available. Translating text never changes calculations or saved builds.
adminShell.sourcesDescription: Previously approved translations are already in the editor's baseline catalog. New publications are versioned in Cloudflare D1; drafts and edit history are available in the protected admin area. Modern no longer publishes translations from Excel files.
adminShell.catalogDescription: The catalog is the only editor for newly added equipment, Souls and skills. The translation center shows published texts and opens their catalog cards. Catalog drafts can be published as one revision without duplicating translation data.
